title: User Login
user_story: As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can securely access my account.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in with valid email and password
Error message is displayed for invalid password
Validation message is displayed when mandatory fields are empty
User is redirected to the dashboard after successful login
manual_test_cases: Verify successful login with valid email and password
Verify error message for invalid password
Verify validation message when email is empty
Verify validation message when password is empty
Verify locked account cannot log in
Verify user is redirected to the dashboard after successful login
